title: SandpaneTaskEvent
description: Durable, replayable task log entry (specs/02 §3 task_events). Sequence is unique per task and strictly increasing; clients reconnect with afterSequence.

kind.description: Event kind. Core-emitted kinds include: task.created, status.changed, message.user, adapter.unavailable, scheduler.deferred, workspace.removing, workspace.removed, workspace.removal_failed, and (A6, design 2026-10-09 §3.6 item 8) git.apply.started (appended durably before the first host write), git.applied, git.apply.failed and git.apply.reconciled (restart reconciliation of an unterminated start: outcome applied, partial, not_applied or unknown, never assumed), and (A7, design 2026-10-09 §3.7 item 5) verification.started {runId, commandId, label, argv, sandbox, workspaceMode} (appended durably in the run's start transaction, before sbx exec is spawned) and verification.finished {runId, startedSequence, outcome, exitCode?, stdoutBytes, stderrBytes, stdoutTruncated, stderrTruncated, redactions, elapsedMs, outputIncomplete?} (outputIncomplete is present, true, only when the process exited while its output was still held open by an escaped descendant) — exactly one per run; interruption (graceful shutdown or restart reconciliation) is verification.finished with outcome interrupted and no output counts. Verification OUTPUT is never in an event; it is read with verification.result. Kinds are an open string set, not an enum. Agent-normalized kinds follow agent-event.schema.json type values.

payload.description: Kind-specific payload; for normalized agent events matches agent-event.schema.json.

timestamp.description: RFC3339 UTC, assigned by Core (stable replays).
